title: Page 8
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
“他说如果你愿意把孩子拿掉，他就跟你离婚，也不再追究伯父曾经对耿家犯过的罪行，从此两不相欠，男婚女嫁各不相干。”杨子谦缓缓转述了耿伯恩的决定。

“佳梨，既然他都这样说了，你就干脆接受这个条件吧？”孟瑞泰虽然已经知道女儿的心意，但耿柏恩能不能完全释怀也很难说，他并不希望拿女儿的一辈子当赌注，冒险持续这桩婚姻。

“是啊，佳梨，趁这个机会重新来过，我会照顾你的。”杨子谦原本绝望的心，忍不住又涌起一丝希望。

男婚女嫁各不相干啊……孟佳梨垂睫好似在思索着什么，长长的睫毛在她的眼下投下一道阴影，久久没有开口。

孟瑞泰与杨子谦互看了一眼，都在彼此眼中看到了忐忑与期待。

比起耿柏恩，孟瑞泰的确更希望女儿可以跟杨子谦在一起，女人就是要找一个爱自己多一点的男人，杨子谦绝对符合这个资格。

当年女儿将这位学长介绍给他认识时，他就挺欣赏这个小伙子，加上后来他生病时，杨子谦也尽心尽力的替他安排一切，承诺一定会好好照顾佳梨，让他无后顾之忧的出国休养治疗，让他对他更是赞誉有加，原本他还以为他们最终会走在一块，没想到……唉。

“想得美……”孟佳梨突然动了动唇瓣，小声嘟囔着。

“你说什么？”孟瑞泰跟杨子谦异口同声的问。

“他想就这样甩开我跟宝宝，想得美！”她的唇畔弯起抹浅浅的弧度，加大了音量重复说道。

“你这孩子——”孟瑞泰懊恼的用拐杖敲了敲地板。

而一旁的杨子谦倒没有太大的失望，也许在内心深处，早已知道她的答案了。

“那你打算怎么做？”他压抑心头的苦涩，坦然的接受她的决定。

“等。”孟佳梨简短的道。

“等？”杨子谦没想到会是这个回答。

孟佳梨轻轻颔首，低声道：“等。”而且她相信，应该不会等太久。

果然如孟佳梨所料，不对，应该出乎她意料之外，她根本连等都不用等，在杨子谦传达她坚持拒绝拿掉孩子的讯息后，耿柏恩的身影马上就出现在病房中，距离她说出“等”这个字，不到半个小时。

杨子谦刚好带孟瑞泰回去休息，所以病房内只剩下她一个人，恰恰方便她好好跟耿柏恩谈谈。

“你该死的为什么不答应？！”耿柏恩一进病房就忍不住低吼。

“你来啦？”孟佳梨虽然因他快速的出现感到惊讶，语气却听不出丝毫情绪，平静的反问。

耿柏恩看着躺在病床上，瘦弱得彷佛就要消失在床垫中的孟佳梨，喉咙好像被紧紧掐住似的，几乎要无法呼吸。

天知道他有多想来看她，想告诉她自己不该不信任她，想告诉她一直以来，他其实都是喜欢着她，暗恋着她，可是他却无法面对自己曾怎样的伤害她，羞辱她。

想起他用卑劣手段逼她签下契约婚姻，想起他粗暴的占有了她的第一次，想起他曾对她说过每一字每一句的言语霸凌，想起越多，他就越失去见她的勇气。

他不该再出现在她的生命中的，就如她不该失去光彩，病恹恹的躺在病床上。

“我把离婚协议书带来了，还有人工流产同意书。”耿柏恩忍住胸腔中翻滚的情绪，冷酷的将装着文件的牛皮纸袋放在了她的床头，“名字我已经签好，就差你的了，孩子拿掉，我愿意放你自由，我们到此为止吧。”

“不要。”孟佳梨简单明了的表达了自己的意思，爽快的让耿柏恩有点来不及反应。

“不要？”他狼狈憔悴的脸上满是错愕。

“没错，不要！”她发音不标准吗？

“为什么？”她应该要很高兴能解脱才是啊。“若是你有其它条件可以提出来，我答应就是了，只要你愿意拿掉孩子，一切好谈。”

“你就这么讨厌我跟孩子？非要快点摆脱我们才甘愿？”孟佳梨半坐起身，脸上浮上一层浓浓的哀怨。

这句话的逻辑怎么有点怪？明明就是他强迫她嫁给自己，她应该要为了可以摆脱这桩契约婚姻而高兴才对啊。

耿柏恩深深瞅着她，缓缓摇头，“不，我只是在导正一开始的错误，我不该逼你嫁给我。”后来他看了父亲的遗书才知道，里面有张孟瑞泰签的本票，且父亲在死前得知了孟瑞泰背叛他的真正原因之后，已经释怀原谅了他，正如外婆所说，父亲只希望自己可以抛开仇恨，开心快乐的过日子，跟自己深爱的女人共组家庭，拥有幸福美满的人生。

可惜，一切都来不及了，他伤害了他最心爱的女人……

孟佳梨迎视着他，眸中闪灿着光芒，似笑非笑的道：“你怎么不觉得是我顺势嫁给你呢？”

耿柏恩的心猛的一突，她话中的含意让他的脑子第一次感到无法思考，手掌心甚至因为紧张而微微湿凉了起来。

“就是这样。”看他望着自己的呆愣表情，还真像极了小时候的傻瓜耿柏恩，“虽没预期我们会那样重逢，但在我心中，或许已经等着那个我喜欢的胖小子很久很久了，虽然过程不是很舒服，但嫁给你我从不勉强，甚至我很开心能成为你的妻子，乐于为了你放弃工作，并不认为这是种折磨。”

耿柏恩只听到自己耳边传来那一阵阵如擂鼓似的心跳声，一声大过一声，彷佛有种强烈的情绪要从胸腔迸裂而出。

“所以，你觉得我好不容易让你娶了我，还有可能会愿意跟你离婚吗？”她眉眼弯弯，露齿一笑，坚定的道：“总之，这辈子我是跟定你了，你就认命吧，我不会离婚，也绝对不可能拿掉孩子，知道了吗？”

他没听错吧？她刚刚的意思是，她早就在他还是那个胖小子的时候就喜欢上他了吗？

“你为什么不说话？这是我第一次跟男人表白，你好歹说些什么吧？”孟佳梨咬咬下唇，憔悴的脸颊泛起了淡淡的红晕。

“表……表白？你说你早就喜欢我了？”耿柏恩实在很难相信，这么美好的事情会发生在自己身上。

“我刚刚说的是中文吧？”这么明显了还听不出来吗？

“你不恨我？在经历过我对你做的那一些可恶行为……”他的声音竟然带着软弱的颠抖。

“除非你不爱我，那就真的是我这辈子遇过最可恶的行为了。”她打趣道，但眼中已经因为情感的激荡而盈满了泪光，朝他展开双臂，等待他的反应。

“我爱你，我怎么可能不爱你？我爱你好久好久好久，早在第一眼看到你的时候就无法克制的爱上你了。”耿柏恩再也无法抗拒自己对她的强烈爱意，倾身将她牢牢抱在怀中，恨不得将她揉入自己的体内，永远不再分开。

“第一眼？”泪水模糊了孟佳梨的视线，她将脸埋入他的胸膛，贪婪的嗅闻着属于他的男人气息，一直紧绷的心此刻终于可以安放在他身上。

“第一眼。”耿柏恩肯定的强调，早在当年父亲带着他，介绍孟伯父跟她给他认识时，他就喜欢上那个有着坚毅眼神的女孩了。

第10章(2)

“我那时很凶耶。”她自他怀中抬起头，笑容甜美。

“那不是凶，那是有个性。”他捧着她的脸，怀疑自己怎么这么幸运，经过了这么多风风雨雨，竟然还能拥有她，老天爷待他何其宽容。
content_en:
"He said that if you are willing to get rid of the child, he will divorce you and will no longer pursue the crimes that uncle has committed against the Geng family. From now on, we will have nothing to do with each other, and marriage between men and women will have nothing to do with each other." Yang Ziqian slowly relayed Geng Bern's decision.

"Jia Li, since he said so, why don't you simply accept this condition?" Although Meng Ruitai already knew his daughter's thoughts, it was hard to say whether Geng Bo'en could completely let go. He did not want to use his daughter's life as a bet and risk continuing this marriage.

"Yes, Jia Li, take this opportunity to start over, and I will take care of you." Yang Ziqian's originally desperate heart couldn't help but feel a glimmer of hope.

Marriage between men and women has nothing to do with each other... Meng Jiali lowered her eyelashes as if thinking about something, her long eyelashes cast a shadow under her eyes, and she didn't speak for a long time.

Meng Ruitai and Yang Ziqian glanced at each other, and they both saw anxiety and expectation in each other's eyes.

Compared to Geng Boen, Meng Ruitai indeed hopes that her daughter can be with Yang Ziqian. A woman just wants to find a man who loves her more, and Yang Ziqian definitely meets this qualification.

When his daughter introduced the senior to him, he admired the young man very much. When he fell ill later, Yang Ziqian tried his best to arrange everything for him and promised to take good care of Jia Li and let him go abroad for recuperation without any worries. This made him praise him even more. Originally, he thought they would end up together, but he didn't expect... Sigh.

"What a beautiful thought..." Meng Jiali suddenly moved her lips and murmured softly.

"What did you say?" Meng Ruitai and Yang Ziqian asked in unison.

"He wants to just get rid of me and the baby, what a beautiful idea!" She curved her lips in a slight arc and repeated in a louder voice.

"You kid-" Meng Ruitai tapped the floor with his crutch in frustration.

Yang Ziqian on the side was not too disappointed. Perhaps deep down in his heart, he already knew her answer.

"Then what are you going to do?" He suppressed the bitterness in his heart and accepted her decision calmly.

"Wait." Meng Jiali said briefly.

"Wait?" Yang Ziqian didn't expect this answer.

Meng Jiali nodded slightly and whispered: "Wait." And she believed that the wait should not take too long.

It was just as Meng Jiali expected, no, it was beyond her expectation. She didn't even have to wait. After Yang Ziqian conveyed the message that she insisted on refusing to take away the child, Geng Boen's figure immediately appeared in the ward, less than half an hour after she said the word "wait".

Yang Ziqian happened to take Meng Ruitai back to rest, so she was the only one left in the ward, which was convenient for her to have a good talk with Geng Bo'en.

"Why the hell didn't you agree?!" Geng Bo'en couldn't help but growl as soon as he entered the ward.

"Are you here?" Although Meng Jiali was surprised by his quick appearance, there was no emotion in her tone and she asked calmly.

Geng Bo'en looked at Meng Jiali, who was lying on the hospital bed. She was so thin that she seemed to disappear into the mattress. Her throat seemed to be pinched tightly, making it almost impossible to breathe.

God knows how much he wanted to see her, wanted to tell her that he shouldn't distrust her, wanted to tell her that he had actually liked her and had a crush on her all along, but he couldn't face how he had hurt her and humiliated her.

Thinking of the despicable means he used to force her to sign a contract marriage, of the first time he violently took possession of her, of the verbal bullying he had said to her every word, the more he thought of it, the more he lost the courage to see her.

He shouldn't appear in her life again, just like she shouldn't lose her luster and lie sickly in the hospital bed.

"I brought the divorce agreement and the abortion consent form." Geng Bo'en suppressed the emotions rolling in his chest and coldly placed the brown paper bag containing the documents on her bedside. "I have already signed the name, and the only thing missing is yours. Take the child away, and I am willing to let you go free. Let's stop here."

"No." Meng Jiali expressed her meaning simply and clearly, so cheerfully that Geng Bo'en had no time to react.

"No?" His haggard and haggard face was full of astonishment.

"That's right, don't!" Doesn't her pronunciation sound correct?

"Why?" She should be very happy to be freed."If you have other conditions you can put forward, I will agree to it. As long as you are willing to take away the child, everything will be easy to negotiate."

"Do you hate me and the children so much? Do you have to get rid of us quickly?" Meng Jiali sat up halfway, with a heavy layer of sadness on her face.

Why is the logic of this sentence a bit weird?It was obviously him who forced her to marry him, so she should be happy to get out of this contract marriage.

Geng Bo'en looked at her deeply and shook his head slowly, "No, I'm just correcting the mistake at the beginning. I shouldn't force you to marry me." Later, he found out after reading his father's suicide note that there was a promissory note signed by Meng Ruitai in it, and his father learned about it before he died.After Meng Ruitai betrayed him for the real reason, he had forgiven him. Just as his grandmother said, his father only hoped that he could put aside his hatred, live happily, start a family with the woman he loved deeply, and live a happy life.

Unfortunately, it was too late, he hurt his most beloved woman...

Meng Jiali looked at him, her eyes shining brightly, and she said with a half-smile, "Why don't you think it was me who took advantage of the situation to marry you?"

Geng Boen's heart suddenly pounded. The implications of her words made his mind unable to think for the first time, and the palms of his hands even became slightly clammy due to nervousness.

"That's it." The blank expression on his face when he looked at me really looked like the fool Geng Boen when he was a child. "Although I didn't expect that we would meet again like that, in my heart, I may have been waiting for the fat boy I like for a long, long time. Although the process is not very comfortable, I will never force myself to marry you. I am even very happy to be your wife. I am happy to give up my job for you, and I don't think it is torture."

Geng Bo'en only heard the beating of heartbeats like drums in his ears, one sound louder than the other, as if a strong emotion was about to burst out of his chest.

"So, do you think I'm still willing to divorce you after I finally got you to marry me?" She arched her eyebrows, smiled, and said firmly: "In short, I am committed to you in this life, so just accept your fate. I will not divorce, and I will never take away the child. Do you understand?"

Did he hear it correctly?Did she just mean that she had already fallen in love with him when he was still that fat boy?

"Why don't you speak? This is the first time I confess to a man, can you say something?" Meng Jiali bit her lower lip, a faint blush on her haggard cheeks.

"Confess... Confession? You said you have liked me a long time ago?" Geng Bo'en found it hard to believe that such a beautiful thing would happen to him.

"What I just said was in Chinese, right?" It's so obvious and you still can't hear it?

"You don't hate me? After all the hateful things I did to you..." His voice actually trembled with weakness.

"Unless you don't love me, that's really the most abominable behavior I've ever encountered in my life." She joked, but her eyes were already filled with tears from the emotion, and she opened her arms towards him, waiting for his reaction.

"I love you, how could I not love you? I have loved you for a long, long time. I couldn't help but fall in love with you when I first saw you." Geng Bo'en could no longer resist his strong love for her. He leaned over and held her tightly in his arms, wishing to rub her into his body and never be separated again.

"First sight?" Tears blurred Meng Jiali's vision. She buried her face in his chest, greedily smelling his manly scent. Her heart, which had been tense, could finally rest on him.

"At first sight." Geng Bo'en affirmed that he had fallen in love with the girl with the determined eyes as early as when his father took him to introduce Uncle Meng to her.

Chapter 10(2)

"I was very fierce then." She raised her head from his arms with a sweet smile.

"That's not fierce, that's personality." He held her face, wondering how he could be so lucky. After so many ups and downs, he could still have her. How forgiving God was to him.
